Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-non-consent-exception

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-non-consent-exception defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
supervision-timing-inconsistent Supervision timing inconsistencyA selected immutable source records supervision intervals extending outside the session or joining after its end/deadline. Preserve the specific interval and original reason; not client-presence timing_gap or a payment verdict.
provider-credential-not-verified Provider credential not verifiedThe selected source explicitly reports its required provider credential snapshot unavailable or unacceptable. Preserve which condition applies; snapshot presence alone is not current license verification.
sealed-frame-history-conflict Sealed-frame history conflictThe selected immutable source records a predecessor-hash mismatch between stored frame histories. Distinct from a missing sequence, including a subsequently closed gap; not a determination of intentional alteration.
provider-session-overlap Provider session overlapThe provider's own active session intervals overlap. Excludes supervision tag-in segments inside another provider's session. Non-blocking factual review condition, never a refusal to Start.
